simple.meaning: עֲרֻבָּה (ʻărubbâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “something given as security , i.e. (literally) a token (of safety) or (metaphorically) a bondsman.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in 1 Samuel, Proverbs, beginning at 1 Samuel 17:18. The surrounding contexts include family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲרֻבָּה (H6161) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
